title: Route reading odds to the reference when it scores better
summary: Gives OLY-B-A2-03 (queued job 20261030-024659-qkzw, which produced no candidate, so nothing is kept or dropped) a mechanism and acts on the parked forecast-use request. When recorded scores show the reader's event Brier worse than the reference, with enough jobs, the committed odds come from the reference. The audience is Sri and the verifier. The time forecast and the timeout guard stay.

defaults_applied.how: The change is Rust in athena-core.
New tests for the override, and fmt, clippy and test are required.
Criteria check the committed odds changing, not wiring.
The requirement is enforced in code and recorded in spec.toml.
One option out of the parked list is chosen.
Criteria are checkable by cargo commands.
The outcome is reader Brier compared with the reference.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Previous job 20261030-024659-qkzw is queued, unverified, with no findings and no candidate files. This request takes over its work: the OLY-B-A2-03 mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, and a test that fails without the mechanism.

Chosen option: replace the reader's three event odds with the reference's when the reader's aggregate event skill against the reference is negative and at least MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL jobs are scored. Otherwise the reader's odds stand. The reader's cost and time quantiles are kept, because the timeout guard needs them. Skill is measured per class of work where the class has enough jobs, otherwise globally.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (build_reading around lines 694-805: the reader forecast is built and validated, then check_reading_size, then scoring::reference), crates/athena-score/src/lib.rs (brier, aggregate, event_skill, MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL, reference_forecast) and docs/spec.toml (OLY-B-A2-03 has mechanism none). The new override goes after the size guard and before the Forecasts are committed. Skill is computed from existing Score records through athena_score::aggregate, so the property is measured directly. No new record or data file under crates/ is added, so the records allow-list (check_record_file, AnyRecord) is unaffected.

The override only changes the committed forecast; scoring still scores the committed reader forecast and the reference, so skill can recover. The skill is also shown in the `athena status` output, so the spec measure can name an existing status line. The producer picks the line after reading crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs.
The reader prompt files are at their token budgets, so no prompt files change.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new unit test in crates/athena-core (reading.rs tests) builds a reading with scored history where reader event skill is negative over at least MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL jobs. It asserts the committed p_reading_accepted, p_verification_passes and p_user_intervenes equal the reference's. It passes under `cargo test -p athena-core` and fails when the override is removed.
A second test with positive skill, or fewer than MIN_JOBS_FOR_SKILL jobs, asserts the reader's own odds are kept. Run with `cargo test -p athena-core`.

The existing timeout-guard tests (a_reading_forecasting_more_than_the_producer_timeout_is_refused_with_advice_to_pick_one_deliverable and the verifier variant) still pass, and the reader's wall_time_s quantiles are never replaced. Run with `cargo test`.

In docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-A2-03 has a mechanism naming the new function in crates/ (no longer "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` with the test that shows it.
The spec text for OLY-B-A2-03 is unchanged, and records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows are not modified.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` pass (standing defaults: tested, verified).

Docs state the experiment's outcome check: calibration is judged by the reader's Brier against the reference after the change. CHANGELOG.md gets one entry. This change adds no new refusal rule and refuses no extra readings, so expected 0% of newly refused readings.

out_of_scope: Removing the odds from the reader's output schema or prompt (prompt files have no token room).
Changing the timeout guard (check_reading_size) or the time forecast.
Planning-skip or job-ordering based on the odds.
Rewriting the scoring rules version, or past score records.
records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows, setup.sh, and cargo or lint configuration.
departures: Hard-job pipeline change touching the reading step; cost and time are above the reference, and pass odds are slightly lower.
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline's reading step: which forecasts get committed and then scored, and it reaches the guard that refuses readings.
